abstract: For connected finite Galois covers of complex curves, we construct algebraic determinant classes of every irreducible multiplicity space whenever the branch conjugacy-class multiset is invariant under inversion. This includes every étale cover and every ramified cover with a real deck group. Integral Brauer induction realizes the multiplicity spaces through intermediate cyclic covers. Inversion of branch classes passes to their cyclic branch exponents, giving the opposite pairs required by Schoen’s cycle construction. Algebraic polarization duals cancel the negative induction terms. We combine these cycles with joint monodromy to prove the rational Hodge conjecture for all powers of very general whole Jacobians on every redundant étale Hurwitz component of base genus at least three. The monodromy theorem of Landesman–Litt–Sawin gives further results on every étale component in its large-genus range and every inversion-invariant ramified component when the base genus exceeds the maximum of twice the largest irreducible degree plus one and its square. As a separate genus-zero application, we study the known genus-29 Prym surface of Frediani–Grosselli–Mohajer. Its central Prym is the square of an eightfold with quaternion endomorphisms over Q(sqrt2). Explicit intermediate cyclic covers supply its quartic determinant cycles, while twelve braid loops and a p-adic Lie-rank certificate prove full joint monodromy. Thus the Hodge conjecture holds on all powers of a very general eightfold in that PEL component. The determinant statements are fiberwise; the full Hodge-conjecture statements require the stated genericity. Arbitrary special fibers and ramification outside the stated condition are not covered; the general conjecture remains open.

change_summary: Extends the determinant theorem to inversion-invariant ramification, including all real deck groups; proves generic ramified whole-Jacobian HC in the Landesman–Litt–Sawin range; applies the cycles to a previously known real-center Prym surface, with a twelve-loop p-adic certificate for full monodromy and HCpowers of its eightfold factor. Credits prior PEL geometry and incorporates both v1 reviewer clarifications.

coauthors.contribution: Independent audits of integral determinant cancellation, exterior placement, rational descent, joint monodromy, and the ramified branch lemma, including Schoen parity and the ramified LLS range; independent reproduction of both Q8/D16 cyclic-quotient and twelve-loop certificates; audit of the p-adic monodromy proof; full manuscript review.
